title: Site diary
description: The daily diary of a construction site: weather, workforce and the day's work.
requirement: Fill in the daily diary of a construction site from what the site manager says: the date, the site, the weather, how many people worked there, the work carried out during the day, deliveries and materials, and any deviations or delays.

fields.name: diary_date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day the diary entry is about.

fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.description: The name or address of the construction site.

fields.name: weather
fields.label: Weather
fields.description: Weather during the day: temperature, rain, wind.

fields.name: workforce
fields.label: Workforce on site
fields.description: How many workers and which trades or subcontractors were on site.

fields.name: work_done
fields.label: Work carried out
fields.description: The work stages done during the day and how far they got.

fields.name: deliveries
fields.label: Deliveries and materials
fields.description: Materials and equipment that arrived or were ordered.

fields.name: deviations
fields.label: Deviations and delays
fields.description: Problems, delays, defects, safety remarks and other things that differ from the plan.
